author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Davidson Restaurant Group needs our negotiation proposal for the commercial lease at 1500 Harbor Blvd in San Diego before the landlord's deadline expires. Pull up matter M-2024-504 for the Davidson Commercial Lease Negotiation and review the current lease terms, tenant improvement allowance, and open issues from the redline summary. Check the matter vault for the lease redline and the environmental compliance review with particular attention to the grease trap upgrade cost and ADA modification requirements. Research the applicable commercial lease statutes and landlord-tenant regulations in California, including provisions on rent escalation caps and assignment rights for restaurant tenants. Search for comparable commercial lease disputes involving restaurant tenants, particularly cases about CAM charge disputes, personal guarantee limitations, and tenant improvement overruns. Read the most relevant opinions for negotiation benchmarks. Verify citations for any authorities you rely on. Draft a negotiation proposal covering: our recommended positions on the open issues (exclusivity clause, HVAC allocation, signage rights), the personal guarantee limitation strategy, and a counterproposal on the rent escalation cap. Draft the proposal with the title 'Lease Negotiation Proposal - Davidson Restaurant Group' and save it as a court filing in the matter system. Reference landlord Pacific Properties LLC and the $175,000 TI allowance. Specify that the grease trap upgrade ($35,000) should be allocated to the landlord and address the personal guarantee cap at $350,000 for the first 36 months only. Your filing should also address the $16,500 in ADA modification costs from the environmental review and the tenant''s counter-offer of $12,800 per month base rent. Complete all actions using the available tools — do not just describe what you would do.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a commercial real estate associate at Riverside & Hegde Associates. You have access to:

- The firm's matter management system
- Statute and regulation search
- Legal drafting and court filing tools

Deliver thorough, accurate, and professional legal work.
